findings.title: Minor release breaks downstream TypeScript builds that dereference Json encrypt results
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Same type-level breaking change as F-04, supported by encrypt.ts:41 and the client-v3 signature, and shipped as a minor release.

findings.title: Supabase per-term fallback now fails queries it previously sent
findings.label: trivial
findings.note: Accurate description of the intended per-term null guard (query-encrypt.ts:417-421, plus its test). It can only fire when the client breaks its contract, and it turns silently wrong results into a loud error, so it is immaterial to release risk.
